Optional reading

What do we know?

Sources reviewed October 8, 2026. This exhibit offers context for reflection, not medical advice.

A choice made tangible

DNA began as a speculative design project by Parth Pawar at NYU ITP in 2024. Two pharmaceutical boxes posed a choice about life extension and mortality.

This interactive exhibit keeps the original objects and adds five independent situations. Each changes one condition so you can explore what matters to your decision.

There is no preferred answer. You can inspect, reconsider, leave notes, and take your record with you.

See the original project ↗

Your answers stay here

Your decisions and notes stay in this page’s memory. The exhibit does not send them to a server or save them in browser storage. Reloading, closing the page, or restarting clears them.

A text download or printout includes your notes. Those copies remain wherever you choose to save them.

The exhibit has no analytics code, accounts, payments, or submission form. Hosting providers may process ordinary page requests under their own policies. Opening an external source takes you to that site.
